easy.q: A rubber-bodied boy and his Straw Hat crew sail the Grand Line in search of a legendary treasure.
An outcast ninja boy with a sealed fox spirit dreams of becoming the leader of his village.
A monkey-tailed boy hunts for seven magic orbs that grant a wish and keeps getting stronger.
Humanity hides behind enormous walls to survive giant man-eating monsters.
A genius student finds a notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it.
A boy from Pallet Town travels the world with his Pikachu to become a Master.
Two brothers use alchemy to search for a legendary stone after a forbidden ritual costs them their bodies.
A high schooler swallows a cursed finger and joins a school of sorcerers who fight curses.
A kind boy with a scar on his forehead hunts demons to turn his sister back into a human.
In a world where most people have superpowers, a Quirkless boy inherits the power of the number one hero.
A teen detective is shrunk into a child's body by a shady organization and keeps solving crimes.
A blue robot cat from the future helps a clumsy boy with gadgets from a pocket.
A bored hero with a plain look can defeat any enemy with a single punch.
A clumsy schoolgirl with long twin tails becomes a sailor-suited warrior who fights evil.
A girl's parents turn into pigs, so she works in a bathhouse for spirits to save them.
Two sisters meet a giant, fluffy forest spirit and ride a cat-shaped bus.
A boy takes the Hunter Exam to find his father, a legendary Hunter.
A short boy with amazing jumping skills joins a high school volleyball team.
A spy, an assassin and a telepathic girl pretend to be an ordinary family.
A teen who can see ghosts becomes a Soul Reaper with a giant sword.
A poor young man merges with a chainsaw devil and becomes a devil hunter.
Thousands of players are trapped in a virtual reality game where dying means dying for real.
A student becomes half-ghoul after an organ transplant and struggles to live in both worlds.
A boy born without magic in a world of mages aims to become the Wizard King.
Bounty hunters travel through space to the sound of jazz.
Two teens secretly swap bodies, and a comet changes everything.
A fire-breathing wizard and his flying blue cat join a famous magic guild.
Humanity is turned to stone for thousands of years, and a science genius rebuilds civilization.

medium.q: A self-proclaimed mad scientist discovers a way to send text messages to the past with a modified microwave.
An exiled prince gains a power that lets him command anyone to obey, and leads a rebellion against an empire.
Teenagers pilot giant biomechanical machines to defend a city from beings called Angels.
A shut-in is summoned to another world and returns to a checkpoint every time he dies.
A young Viking warrior seeks revenge, then searches for a land without war.
An awkward middle schooler with huge psychic powers tries to live a normal life.
A former soldier becomes a letter-writing Auto Memory Doll to understand human emotions.
A lazy, sweet-loving samurai takes odd jobs in an Edo overrun by aliens.
Students at a school for weapon partners collect souls to create a death scythe.
Seven mages summon heroic spirits to fight for a wish-granting Holy Grail.
A boy with a scary face and a tiny, fierce girl team up to win each other's crushes.
People who die play deadly games in a bar to decide whether they are reincarnated or sent to the void.
A teenager's right hand is taken over by an alien parasite named Migi.
A girl and a robot boy descend into a giant, dangerous hole full of relics.
Orphans discover that their cozy orphanage is secretly a farm raising children for demons.
Two genius student council members try to make the other confess first.
In a future society, a system measures people's chance of committing a crime.
A ronin with prosthetic body parts hunts demons to reclaim his stolen body.
Soccer players compete in a facility to forge the most selfish striker in the country.
A doctor is reborn as the child of his favorite idol.
After the hero party defeats the Demon King, an elf mage sets out to understand humans.
A boy from a family diner enrolls in an elite cooking academy and battles rivals in intense food duels.

hard.q: A brilliant surgeon saves a boy's life and later hunts the killer the boy became.
A wandering healer helps people troubled by mysterious life forms.
A quiet girl becomes entangled with a worldwide computer network known as the Wired.
A golden-bat-wielding kid attacks stressed-out people in Tokyo.
A boy with a drill digs underground and ends up piercing the heavens with a giant robot.
A cyborg agent of Section 9 hunts a hacker called the Puppet Master.
In Neo-Tokyo, a biker gang member's friend develops dangerous psychic powers.
A doughnut-loving gunman with a huge bounty wanders the desert preaching love and peace.
A vampire servant of a British organization hunts monsters.
A lone swordsman with a giant blade seeks revenge in a dark fantasy world.
Two women with the same name meet on a train and share an apartment in Tokyo.
Space-debris collectors work in near-future orbit and dream of the stars.
A wandering swordsman, a street-style rebel and a waitress search for the samurai who smells of sunflowers.
A former gang member becomes a teacher for the toughest students.
Two brothers promise to become astronauts, and the younger one gets there first.
A figure skater who lost a big competition gets coached by a Russian star.
A swordless swordsman and a strategist collect twelve legendary swords.
A vast space opera about two brilliant commanders in a war between an empire and an alliance.
Winged beings with halos live in a walled town and care for newcomers who hatch from cocoons.
